opening.argument: The video is centered on the creator’s firsthand account and criticism of OneCoin, including his statement that he is “no longer with OneCoin what so ever” and his effort to “tell the facts, tell what happened with my experience.” He reports putting more than two thousand dollars into OneCoin, being unable to withdraw his money, and losing access after criticizing the coin. He further challenges its foundations, stating, “There is no solid technology Their is no external There is no mining of the coin.” Although he offers to help viewers sell the coin for a ten-dollar amount, the video does not establish a deceptive promise or fraudulent money flow for that proposed service.
